## Keyframes

`ease` — how the frame is *arrived at*: `kime` snap, `soft` settle, `pass` flow through.
`(auto)` means the engine derived it; it is not written in the JSON.  
`hold` — seconds frozen on this frame before the next move starts. `clamped` means the
requested hold did not fit in the gap (max half of it) and was cut.  
`travel` marks a frame pushed to 25% into its step because it collided with the previous
step's last frame — that first quarter of the step is the step/turn into position.
